in_marathi.name: Devanand
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devanand हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devanand is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘deva’ (god) and ‘anand’ (grace or happiness). This name is bestowed upon a child to signify the presence and blessings of the gods in their life. The name evokes a sense of spiritual connection and divine grace.
